choice_of_declaration: Table 3 (out/tables/t3_cc93.md): every candidate qualifies (no understatement on any settled leaf of any stratum, returned or visited). The rule, fixed here before table 4 was read: V93 takes the qualifying candidate whose median D/true error is smallest on every family it applies to; that is pair93 (median 5.85 on the Clenshaw-Curtis strata's group leaves, 34.8 on the bands' group leaves, 605 on the bands' analytic leaves; min 1.18), at 92 extra evaluations a Clenshaw-Curtis leaf. tail93, the qualifying candidate with no extra evaluations and the next smallest overstatement (6.55, 45.9, 605; min 1.18), is run beside it as one of the agent's own (V93tail).
